correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonal monomial gamma moments establish a diagonal H*H formula with no unjustified infinite-dimensional numerics. Fixed-parameter gamma-ratio remainder is uniform in coordinate proportions, with strictly positive angular factor; bounded radial rescaling and measure-zero radial boundary make lattice Riemann sums rigorous. Singular-count inversion and the logarithmic trace are elementary consequences; quartic two-variable beta integral equals 31/640 by exact rational arithmetic.

originality.rationale: The multi-dimensional exact coefficient is not supplied by the 2026 qualitative Fock/Hankel theorem (arxiv:2609.26810), the 2007 known compactness/Schatten threshold (doi:10.1007/s00020-007-1513-1), the 2018 general Schatten criterion (doi:10.1007/s00020-018-2433-y), the 2024 one-variable comparability theorem (arxiv:2410.20082), or the stated complex-plane scope of the 2014 Dixmier trace paper (doi:10.1016/j.jfa.2013.08.007). value.rationale: A precise leading Weyl density and measurable critical Dixmier trace are natural quantitative operator invariants not recoverable from existing boundedness, compactness, Schatten thresholds, or two-sided decay estimates. The beta/simplex angular correction encodes genuine multivariable spectral geometry; the result covers every \(d\ge2\), \(m>1\) and contains a nontrivial exact 31/640 example.
